title: BJMP: Some CCTV footage of Romualdez in Payatas Jail overwritten
summary: Some CCTV footage from the Quezon City Jail in Payatas has already been overwritten, a Bureau of Jail Management and Penology official testified before the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Monday.
